extracted.intended_audience: writers and translators seeking PEN American Center literary awards / submission information
extracted.subtask_description: A listing of PEN American Center literary awards, each with the purpose, eligibility focus, and prize amounts; intended to guide writers, translators, editors, and playwrights about which PEN awards they might qualify for. Covers multiple genres (fiction, nonfiction, translation, poetry, drama, children's/YA, sports writing, biography, editing).

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of PEN Literary Awards
rubrics_metrics.description: The PEN Literary Awards are the most comprehensive in the United States. Each year, with the help of its partners and supporters, PEN confers more than $150,000 to writers in the fields of fiction, science writing, essays, sports writing, biography, children's literature, translation, drama, or poetry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this as a framing criterion: awards span many genres and forms and collectively distribute substantial prize money.

rubrics_metrics.name: PEN/Fusion Emerging Writers Prize
rubrics_metrics.description: for a promising young writer of an unpublished work of nonfiction that addresses a global and/or multicultural issue
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Introduced as an annual award supported by Univision; targets emerging writers and unpublished nonfiction addressing global or multicultural themes.

rubrics_metrics.name: PEN/Heim Translation Fund Grants
rubrics_metrics.description: to promote the publication and reception of translated world literature in English
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grants of $2,000–$4,000 intended to support translation and encourage publication and readership of translated works in English.

rubrics_metrics.name: PEN/Phyllis Naylor Working Writer Fellowship
rubrics_metrics.description: for an author of an unpublished work of children's or young-adult fiction
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A $5,000 fellowship aimed specifically at authors working on unpublished children's or YA fiction.

rubrics_metrics.name: PEN/Ralph Manheim Medal for Translation
rubrics_metrics.description: for a translator whose career has demonstrated a commitment to excellence through the body of his or her work
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A career/honor award recognizing sustained excellence across a translator's body of work (no single-book limitation implied).

rubrics_metrics.name: PEN/Jacqueline Bograd Weld Award for Biography
rubrics_metrics.description: for excellence in the art of biography
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A $5,000 award recognizing distinguished achievement specifically in biographical writing.

rubrics_metrics.name: PEN/Nora Magid Award
rubrics_metrics.description: for a magazine editor whose high literary standards and taste have, throughout his or her career, contributed significantly to the excellence of the publication he or she edits
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A $2,500 award focused on editors: evaluates career-long editorial standards and contribution to a magazine's literary quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: PEN/Robert W. Bingham Prize
rubrics_metrics.description: for an outstanding work of debut fiction
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A $25,000 prize intended to honor an exceptional first work of fiction (debut).

rubrics_metrics.name: PEN/Diamonstein-Spielvogel Award for the Art of the Essay
rubrics_metrics.description: to preserve the dignity and esteem that the essay form imparts to literature
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A $10,000 award celebrating excellence in essay writing and the essay as a literary form.

rubrics_metrics.name: PEN/E. O. Wilson Literary Science Writing Award
rubrics_metrics.description: to celebrate writing that exemplifies literary excellence on the subject of physical and biological sciences
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A $10,000 award for science writing that combines literary quality with coverage of physical or biological sciences.

rubrics_metrics.name: PEN/John Kenneth Galbraith Award for Nonfiction
rubrics_metrics.description: to an author of a distinguished book of general nonfiction possessing notable literary merit and critical perspective and illuminating important contemporary issues
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A $10,000 award for a general nonfiction book that demonstrates literary merit, critical insight, and illumination of contemporary topics.

rubrics_metrics.name: PEN/Laura Pels International Foundation for Theater Awards
rubrics_metrics.description: three awards to honor a Grand Master of American Theater, playwright in mid-career, and emerging playwright
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Awards of $7,500 and $2,500 are given across categories recognizing lifetime achievement, mid-career distinction, and emerging talent in American playwriting.

rubrics_metrics.name: PEN Translation Prize
rubrics_metrics.description: for a distinguished book-length prose translation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A $3,000 award recognizing excellence in translating a book-length prose work into English.

rubrics_metrics.name: PEN Open Book Award
rubrics_metrics.description: for a book-length work by an author of color
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A $5,000 prize aimed at honoring book-length literary work by authors of color; eligibility centers on author identity and the work's length/format.

rubrics_metrics.name: PEN Award for Poetry in Translation
rubrics_metrics.description: for a book-length translation of poetry from any language into English
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A $3,000 award recognizing excellence in translating a full-length book of poetry into English from any source language.

rubrics_metrics.name: PEN/ESPN Award for Literary Sports Writing
rubrics_metrics.description: for an author of a nonfiction book about sports
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A $5,000 award for nonfiction books specifically on sports; evaluates literary quality within sports writing.

rubrics_metrics.name: PEN/ESPN Lifetime Achievement Award for Literary Sports Writing
rubrics_metrics.description: to a writer for their long-time contributions to the field of literary sports writing
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A $5,000 lifetime achievement recognition for sustained contributions to sports-related literary nonfiction.

rubrics_metrics.name: PEN/Joyce Osterweil Award for Poetry
rubrics_metrics.description: for a new and emerging American poet with promise of further literary achievement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A $5,000 award dedicated to early-career American poets judged to show promise of continued accomplishment.
